title: When bringing in Hevy or Strong workouts fails, or undoing it fails, nothing records why and the member has nowhere to turn
what: If saving the imported workouts fails, the member reads 'The import failed. Nothing was changed. Please try again.' If Undo fails, they read 'Couldn't undo the import... Please try again.' In both cases the app throws the real error away without writing it anywhere, and the page offers no Help or 'tell us' button. A member whose file fails every time keeps trying again, and MettleUp cannot find out what went wrong even if the member does reach the help box in Settings.
expected: Both failures write the real error to the app's log, and after a second failure the page offers a way to send the problem (and the file name) to MettleUp.
fix_line: Log the real error on both failures and add a Get help button after a repeat failure

title: A gym name typed on Find my gym is lost without a word when it cannot be sent
what: When no gym is found, the member can type their gym's name and city and tap Tell my gym; the page says the MettleUp team may contact that gym. The name is sent once in the background. If the phone is offline or the server refuses it, the only trace is a line in the phone's own log: the member is not told, it is never sent again, and MettleUp never sees the lead.
expected: An unsent gym name is kept and sent again later, or the member is told it did not go.
fix_line: Keep the lead and retry it when the phone is back online
